characters.name: Apollo Justice
characters.description1: Another lawyer at the office. He's passionate about the law, and hates anything that's not fair or just.
characters.description2: Assaulted during the trial yesterday. Thankfully, he's going to be okay, but he's still at the hospital undergoing treatment.

characters.name: Juniper Woods
characters.description1: Our client in this case. We've been friends since childhood. A sweet girl who loves nature.
characters.description2: The defendant in this case. She's accused of the courtroom bombing and the assault on Apollo.

characters.name: Candice Arme
characters.description1: The victim in this case. A detective who was heading up the investigation into a bombing incident.

characters.name: Athena Cykes
characters.description1: A young, rookie lawyer at our agency. She's also our client's friend.

characters.name: Gaspen Payne
characters.description1: The prosecuting attorney. He just seems to exude unpleasantness...
characters.description2: The prosecuting attorney. The younger brother of another prosecutor I know. This one lacks presence, too...

characters.name: Ted Tonate
characters.description1: A police bomb specialist. He was in charge of handling the bomb that exploded in the courtroom.

evidences.name: Attorney's Badge
evidences.description1: My brand-new, shiny badge. It shows that I'm a defense attorney.* (when playing as Athena Cykes)
evidences.description2: It's my all-important badge. Proof of my profession.* (when playing as Phoenix Wright)

evidences.name: Arme's Autopsy Report
evidences.description1: Cause of death: Trauma to back of head caused by impact with a flat object. Time of death: Between 8 and 11 AM.

evidences.name: HH-3000 Bomb
evidences.description1: The time bomb that destroyed the courtroom. It was hidden inside a stuffed animal when it was detonated.
evidences.description2: It was hidden inside a stuffed animal and can be detonated remotely.

evidences.name: Phony Phanty Tail
evidences.description1: A piece of the stuffed animal that the bomb was inserted into. The defendant's fingerprints were found on it.

evidences.name: Bomb Transport Case
evidences.description1: The case Tonate and Detective Arme transported the bomb in. Tonate has the key.

evidences.name: Missing Remote Switch
evidences.description1: A switch that starts the time bomb's countdown. It was stolen just before the blast and is now missing.

evidences.name: Courtroom No. 4 Diagram
evidences.description1: A diagram of the courtroom as it was when Apollo was discovered after the assault. [caption] The rubble blocks off access to the area around the witness stand.

evidences.name: Apollo's Assault Photo
evidences.description1: Apollo is shown collapsed on the floor. The bloody writing is also visible. [caption] The writing is "L10015."

evidences.name: Courtroom Bombing Photo
evidences.description1: Crime scene photo of the aftermath of the Courtroom No. 4 bombing and the victim. [caption] The victim sits in front of some sharp and pointed rubbles. There is blood on the victim's head trickling down.

evidences.name: Bloody Writing Analysis
evidences.description1: A report that proves that the writing was done in Detective Arme's blood. [caption] The writing is "L10015."

evidences.name: Mr. Wright's Last Will
evidences.description1: "Apollo, sorry I got you caught up in all this. I leave the rest to you. Take good care of everyone, okay?"

evidences.name: Mr. Wright's Cell Phone
evidences.description1: The phone that delivered Mr. Wright's final message to me.

testimonies.testimony: During the trial yesterday... I was overcome by a fit of coughing...
Apollo stayed with me and we went to the courtroom ruins together.
Apollo started looking for Bum Rap Rhiny near the witness stand, where there was no rubble.

source.evidence_span: The rubble blocks off access to the area around the witness stand.
source.testimony_span: Apollo started looking for Bum Rap Rhiny near the witness stand
source.explanation: It was not possible to access the witness stand due to the rubble.

testimonies.testimony: But then I was called back to this courtroom to give testimony...
Apollo insisted on staying behind in Courtroom No. 4.
I swear I didn't attack Apollo! Why would I ever hurt such a kind person?

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Woods describes Apollo's whereabouts after the courtroom was bombed into a ruin.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims Apollo was at the witness stand.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests the witness stand was blocked off by rubble.
Prop 1: If a location was blocked off by rubble, a person could not have been there.
